label: Editable routing checkpoint
title: Added routing instructions can be edited, executed, and lifted again
summary: One editable eight-bit table per axis gives exact recursive program/data lifts under a five-symbol radius-nine interpreter. Routing edits and autonomous copying survive the next lift; inherited edits and newly available edits have distinct contracts.
takeaway: Added routing contents can become physical program data. The order of the program chain, prepared role geometry, and infinite boundary resources remain fixed.
